hints: Every step costs the same. What does that tell you about the order in which to explore?
Explore in rings of equal distance: every cell one step away, then every cell two steps away, and so on. The first time you reach the finish, you are on a shortest route.
That ordering is a queue - a breadth-first search. Push the start, then repeatedly pop a cell and push its unvisited open neighbours.
Mark a cell as visited when you push it, not when you pop it, or the same cell enters the queue once per neighbour.
